sources.title: Jax Build Guide : [26.19] ThisIsPatrik's In-depth Jax Guide

passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.text: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

spells.name: Leap Strike
spells.text: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

spells.name: Empower
spells.text: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

spells.name: Counter Strike
spells.text: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
spells.text: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

damage.value: Jax deals sustained damage through consecutive attacks, with additional Magic Damage on every third attack.

archetype.value: Jax plays as a bruiser who leaps into combat, attacks repeatedly, and uses Counter Strike to protect himself.

axis.value: Jax favors long trades because consecutive attacks build Attack Speed and every third attack deals additional Magic Damage.

winCondition.value: Jax can turn a lead into a win through splitpushing.

spikes.why: Jax can combine a third-hit proc with Empower for a large burst of damage.

spikes.at: When Jax's W reaches its 3-second cooldown
spikes.why: Jax can empower his next attack more often.

bait.why: Jax cannot use Leap Strike again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Jax loses a useful escape option if he swaps away from Stealth Ward and can no longer ward hop.
